mcq_fix.s: Which of the following practices helps conserve water in agriculture?
mcq_fix.why: drop odd meta phrase about gypsum 'in the stated comparison' (yeb13c4efdcd)

mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('criticism or continuing concern') with giveaway distractors

patterns: APPSC asks simple 'which conserves water / suits water-scarce regions' items - answer drip or micro-irrigation against flood/canal distractors.
UPSC-style statement items (fertigation advantages, zero tillage, SRI, SSI, drip benefits) carry the trap options (rock phosphate, gypsum).
Soilless farming definitions (hydroponics = growing without soil) and controlled-environment items recur.
App adds many scheme numbers (PDMC, MIF, DAM outlay, AgriStack) and AP 2026 news well beyond PYQ depth; keep stems direct.
